positions.title: Systems Analyst / Consultant
positions.description:
Assumed the lead technical consultant and technician roll to provide leadership and direction while overhauling and maintaining legacy Bank Card data processes. Performed system analysis and lead efforts to document, support, and overhaul each owned business process with current technologies. Directed collaborations between onshore and offshore BofA assets to ensure on time and on budget delivery of necessary technical enhancement, bug fixes, and additions to Bank Card's IT infrastructure.
Key Results:
Reduced the overall level of severe and critical "trouble tickets" being reported on legacy processes by 90% within 1 year of being assigned to the Bank Card Technical Environment group. 
Personally authored SQL Server Stored Procedure code enhancements and fixes to address a multitude of pre-existing, current, and planned data performance and maintenance issues. 
Documented work/data flows from top to bottom of several dozen business processes providing full scale break downs of process flow, data source information, technical support / disaster recovery instructions, and strategic technology plans to keep each process viable through an extended life cycle.
Managed and maintained a SQL Server 2005 - 2008 infrastructure that spanned development, UAT, staging, production, and disaster recovery servers through daily monitoring, technical issue resolution, and direct support when necessary. 
Wrote low and high level technical specifications and requirements for offshore developer assets when legacy .net code modifications, additions, and corrections were needed to address data environment issues. 
Provided direct code analysis and problem resolution on all owned internal customer interfaces. Interface infrastructure spanned from legacy VB 6.0 and ASP web sites to .Net 4.0 based Smart Clients and Windows WPF applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Helped produce and implement Platform Integration Exchange "PIX" into the Bank of America Card Division. PIX integrated over 30 separate business functions into a singular Microsoft Smart Client interface application that currently serves thousands of associates worldwide in a range of functions including fraud /non-fraud card analysis, external vendor account reconciliation, customer problem resolution, and a multitude of other functions.
Coded a Fee Reconciliation plug in for PIX which utilizes business logic services developed in C# to analyze customer accounts needing adjustment due to fraudulent activity. The process, still in use and utilized by hundreds of associates daily on 2 continents, ensures that Bank of America can successfully reconcile any consumer and business customer's account affected by fraud within federal regulatory guidelines. 
Created and implemented the PIX element Proprietary Cash Dispense. Utilized by all Bank of America Card Customer Service associates, the application analyzes consumer and business customer ATM card cash transactions and alerts associates to any cash dispense errors that result in customers not receiving their funds. 
Developed and implemented several other Windows Service, Web Service, DTS, and SSIS based support services and packages for Card's PIX environment that continue to import and process millions of rows of data and process hundreds of millions in financial transactions annually.  
Business Intelligence Developer
2003 to 2005
Developed data import and presentation packages for various Bank of America Card departments to help bring the division in line with the bank's Manage by Fact, Six Sigma initiative. 
Key Results:
Utilized Cognos 8 with a SQL Server 2000 to create business intelligence reporting for several business lines. Used Cognos data cubes to upgrade and automate Excel based dashboards being manually created and utilized throughout the division for metric reporting.
